content.short: Emerald City DAO provides tools for Web3 builders to craft experiences with great UX.
content.description: Emerald City DAO provides Web3 builders with a robust toolkit to craft experiences that deliver strong UX. Its product lineup includes Emerald Bot, a Discord bot that verifies Flow NFTs and assigns roles; FLOATs, POAP-style badges for Flow; Touchstone, a white-label NFT project creator; Drizzle; and Toucans. Together, these tools streamline NFT management, onboarding, and project development, helping teams prototype and deploy engaging Web3 experiences.
